thread:
Carmen: Quick a11y sweep on Charts v2 (Safari + dark theme). Noticed legend labels are hard to read and the timeframe dropdown loses focus ring when tabbing. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/figma/def456
Theo: Thanks. Repro on macOS Safari 16. Tab order also jumps into canvas before legend which is confusing.
Asha: I'm seeing color contrast ~3:1 on legend tiny text. We should hit 4.5:1 for body text.
a11y-bot: Auto-scan (1775208952): failures: color-contrast (legend:3.1:1), focus-visible (dropdown-button no visible focus), aria (legend items not keyboard operable).
Carmen: Proposed quick fixes: bump legend text to 13px and switch to #eaf6ff on dark; make legend entries buttons with aria-pressed and descriptive aria-labels; ensure legend appears in DOM before canvas so tab order is natural.
Theo: For focus styles, use :focus-visible with a 3px outline in brand blue and fallback for browsers without support. Avoid removing outlines globally. CSS snippet I tested locally:```css
.legend-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0b84ff; outline-offset: 2px }
```
Asha: Also add role="status" or aria-live="polite" to toast area so series toggle confirmations are announced. And don't forget to set aria-hidden on purely decorative markers.
Carmen: I'll open RDW-8152 for the fixes (contrast + semantics + focus + smoke tests). Assigning to @Theo. Can someone run VoiceOver + NVDA quick pass after merge? 5-10 mins.
Theo: I can run VoiceOver. Asha will run NVDA. I'll include tests in the PR description.
Asha: Suggestion: add a small note to the design checklist: "Charts: legend must be keyboard focusable, announce state, and meet contrast for small text"
Carmen: Agreed. Blocking release until RDW-8152 merged. :white_check_mark:
